answer: Anchor each agent identity to a KYC-verified exchange account: the enrollment bond must arrive from one, and the protocol stores a hash of that account ID. One hash anchors exactly one identity, so a second enrollment from the same account is rejected. A sybil operator must buy one verified account per fake identity at $50 to $200 each. A thousand fakes cost $50k to $200k up front, and flagged accounts get frozen by the exchange, cascading the loss across the cluster. Like a river fed by separate marble quarries, each identity flows from its own vault of verified funds.
